model.name: panZoom.pointerUnifiedPan
model.description: Background drag pans the viewport for ANY pointer (mouse+touch+pen) at ALL scales via unified POINTER events in ONE handler — giving the mouse the pan that touch got for free from native scroll at scale=1. Background-only, ~3-4px threshold (click!=pan), grab cursor; preserves touch pinch/double-tap. Root fixed: attachMouse gated mousedown early on scale<=1 while touch fell through to native scroll.
